contexts.text: Mizraim begat Caphtorim, etc. () = so many nations, by which are signified so many rituals.
Philistines from Caphtor () = those who are initiated into interior truths by means of exterior ones, but who pervert them, and apply them to confirm falsities and evils. References.
The interior truths of faith are the Philistines; and the exterior truths are the remains of the isle of Caphtor (). AE 406:13.
